reconstructed_theorem_text:
For every natural number n with 3 <= n, every real kappa with 4 <= kappa, and every real ell with 0 <= ell (including ell = 0), make the following literal definitions. Let G = O(n, R) be the full real orthogonal matrix group, containing both determinant signs, and let E = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n), identified through WithLp.ofLp with R^n. Let mu be Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts G), the actual normalized Haar probability measure on G, and let vol be the canonical Euclidean volume measure on E. Use the true Euclidean norm on E. Let j0 be the coordinate 0 in Fin n, let U(O) = O[j0,j0], and define
A(O) = ((kappa + 1)/2) I_n - ((kappa - 1)/4) (O + O^T),
a(O) = kappa + 1 + 4 ell - (kappa - 1) U(O),
p(O,x) = sqrt(det A(O)) / (2 pi)^(n/2) * exp(-(x dot (A(O) x))/2),
f(O,x) = det(O) * (exp(-ell ||x||_2^2) * p(O,x)),
g(O,x) = det(O) * sqrt(det A(O)) / (2 pi)^(n/2) * exp(-a(O) ||x||_2^2/4).
Here x dot (A(O) x) is the real coordinate dot product supplied by WithLp.ofLp. Every displayed square root is Real.sqrt, the nonnegative real square root. Each dimension-half exponent n/2 is the real number (n : R)/2 and its power is a real power; each exponent n-1 is natural subtraction in N and its power is a natural power.
The conclusion is the conjunction of these three outputs:
(1) f is absolutely Bochner integrable with respect to the product measure mu x vol on G x E;
(2) g is absolutely Bochner integrable with respect to the same product measure;
(3) the following real Bochner integral equality holds:
integral_G det(O) * (integral_E exp(-ell ||x||_2^2) * p(O,x) dvol(x)) dmu(O)
= [(-1)^(n-1) * (sqrt(kappa) - 1)^(n-1) / 2^(n/2)]
  * integral_G [((sqrt(kappa) + 1) * U(O) - (sqrt(kappa) - 1)) / a(O)^(n/2)] dmu(O).
All functions above are the literal real formulas displayed; p is not replaced by an independently characterized Gaussian law. The two joint integrability assertions are conclusions, not hypotheses, and no caller-supplied majorant or Fubini hypothesis is assumed. Integrals use the Mathlib Bochner integration convention.

E is actual EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) with true Euclidean norm. mu is normalized Haar probability Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts G); vol is canonical Euclidean volume. j0=0; U(O)=O[j0,j0]. A(O)=((kappa+1)/2)I_n-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T); a(O)=kappa+1+4ell-(kappa-1)U(O). p(O,x)=sqrt(det A(O))/(2pi)^(n/2)*exp(-(x dot A(O)x)/2). f(O,x)=det(O)*(exp(-ell||x||_2^2)*p(O,x)). g(O,x)=det(O)*sqrt(det A(O))/(2pi)^(n/2)*exp(-a(O)||x||_2^2/4).
semantic_slots.domains: n in N; kappa and ell in R; O in G=O(n,R); x in E=EuclideanSpace R (Fin n); f,g:G x E -> R; U,a:G -> R; p:G -> E -> R; A(O) is a real Fin n by Fin n matrix. Product integration is under mu.prod(vol), with group variable first and Euclidean variable second.
semantic_slots.quantifiers: For all n in N with 3<=n, for all kappa in R with 4<=kappa, and for all ell in R with 0<=ell, the conjunction of both joint integrability outputs and the stated iterated-integral identity holds. All lets depend on these parameters. O and x are bound by their respective functions and integrals.
semantic_slots.assumptions: Only 3<=n, 4<=kappa, and 0<=ell are caller hypotheses. The ell=0 case is included. The stipulated normalized Haar probability and canonical Euclidean structures are the definitions in use. No integrability, majorant, or Fubini premise is imposed, and no separately characterized law or density is assumed for p.
semantic_slots.conclusion: Integrable(f,mu.prod(vol)) and Integrable(g,mu.prod(vol)), both genuine absolute Bochner L1 statements, and integral_G det(O)*(integral_E exp(-ell||x||_2^2)*p(O,x) dvol(x)) dmu(O) = ((-1)^(n-1)*(sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1)/2^(n/2))*integral_G (((sqrt(kappa)+1)*U(O)-(sqrt(kappa)-1))/a(O)^(n/2) dmu(O).
semantic_slots.scopes: Every occurrence of U,a,p,f,g is scoped under the universal n,kappa,ell parameters and their displayed literal definitions. A is only an abbreviation for the repeated matrix formula. In the left iterated integral, x is integrated against vol inside and O against mu outside. The right integral binds only O. Norm squares are natural powers 2 of the true Euclidean norm. Real dimension-half powers occur at (2pi)^(n/2), 2^(n/2), and a(O)^(n/2). Powers (-1)^(n-1) and (sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1) have natural n-1 exponents. Real.sqrt applies to det A(O), and separately to kappa. The integral convention is Mathlib Bochner integration.
semantic_slots.constant_dependencies: There are no existential, unspecified, asymptotic, or universal comparison constants. All numerical factors 1,2,3,4 and pi are literal. The prefactor depends only on n and kappa: (-1)^(n-1)*(sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1)/2^(n/2). The functions depend on the displayed n,kappa,ell and their arguments; mu and vol depend on n through their underlying spaces.
